changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_usage_event ADD COLUMN applied_instance_model_id bigint, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type CHECK (source_type IN ('REVIEW_JOB', 'MENTOR_TURN', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_DECISION', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_EMBEDDING', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_RERANKING', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT', 'PROBE')) NOT VALID, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope CHECK ( (source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND workspace_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL AND lease_epoch IS NULL AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE' AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL) OR (source_type = 'PROBE' AND run_id IS NULL AND lease_epoch IS NULL AND action_id IS NULL AND source_attempt = 0 AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL AND ((workspace_id IS NULL AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE') OR (workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND funding_source = 'WORKSPACE'))) OR (source_type NOT IN ('PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT','PROBE') AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL)) NOT VALID, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call CHECK (call_state <> 'OPEN' OR (source_type = 'PROBE' AND settle_after IS NOT NULL) OR (source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND action_id IS NOT NULL AND settle_after IS NOT NULL) OR (run_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_epoch IS NOT NULL)) NOT VALID;

rollback.sql: -- Keep probe accounting: downgrade only after its rows have passed the configured retention period. DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM llm_usage_event WHERE source_type='PROBE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Probe accounting must expire through retention before rollback'; END IF; END $$; ALTER TABLE llm_usage_event DROP COLUMN applied_instance_model_id; ALTER TABLE llm_usage_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_source_type CHECK (source_type IN ('REVIEW_JOB', 'MENTOR_TURN', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_DECISION', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_EMBEDDING', 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_RERANKING', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_scope CHECK ( (source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND workspace_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL AND lease_epoch IS NULL AND funding_source = 'INSTANCE' AND model_kind = 'CHAT' AND practice_id IS NULL AND review_id IS NULL) OR (source_type <> 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL)), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_usage_event_open_call CHECK (call_state <> 'OPEN' OR ((source_type = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DRAFT' AND action_id IS NOT NULL AND settle_after IS NOT NULL) OR (run_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_epoch IS NOT NULL)));
